title: Dire wolf carcass found at Dry Gulch Creek and matched by biologist Ben Woodruff
place_text: Dry Gulch Creek, Skinwalker Ranch, Utah

tellings.quote: right there on camera the team happens upon this carcass of this decomposing large wolf-like creature

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a find at a spot called Dry Gulch Creek in the 2020s. He says that, on camera for the TV show The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch, his team came upon the rotting body of a large wolf-like animal, which a biologist named Ben Woodruff matched to the dire wolf, a huge wolf thought to be long extinct. If so, it would mean an animal from the distant past was somehow on the ranch.
